# Eternal Isolation: Put target creature with power 4 or greater on the bottom of its owner's library.
# Shapes: Teferi, Timeless Voyager's "Put target creature on top of its owner's library." (MOVE_ZONE to
# Zone(LIBRARY, OWNER, position)) with BOTTOM; the target filter from parse "Destroy target creature
# with power 4 or greater." (B5a-destroy-power-ge).
effect = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
        filter=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_GE, count=QConst(value=4)),
        )),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER, position=ZonePosition.BOTTOM),
})
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.SORCERY, effect=effect)]
